children.heading: 銀行持株会社の子会社の範囲
children.heading_en: Scope of Subsidiaries of a Bank Holding Company
children.summary_ja: 銀行持株会社が子会社にできる会社の種類を列挙し、原則として銀行及びここに掲げる会社以外は子会社にできないことを定める。
children.summary_en: Lists the types of companies a Bank Holding Company may hold as subsidiaries — in principle, only a bank or a company on this list may be held as a subsidiary.

children.text_ja: 銀行持株会社は、銀行及び次に掲げる会社(以下この条及び次条第二項において「子会社対象会社」という。)以外の会社を子会社としてはならない。
children.text_en: A Bank Holding Company shall not have as a subsidiary any company other than a bank and the companies listed below (hereinafter referred to in this Article and Article 52-24, paragraph (2) as "Subsidiary-Eligible Companies").

clauses_ja.text: 銀行持株会社は、銀行及び次に掲げる会社(以下この条及び次条第二項において「子会社対象会社」という。)以外の会社を子会社としてはならない。

clauses_en.text: A Bank Holding Company shall not have as a subsidiary any company other than a bank and the companies listed below (hereinafter referred to in this Article and Article 52-24, paragraph (2) as "Subsidiary-Eligible Companies").

children.text_en: A company specializing in the funds-transfer business.

children.text_ja: 第十六条の二第一項第四号の二に掲げる会社
children.text_en: A company listed in Article 16-2, paragraph (1), item (iv-2) (not digitized in this excerpt).

refs.raw_text: 第十六条の二第一項第四号の二

children.text_ja: 銀行業を営む外国の会社
children.text_en: A foreign company engaged in the banking business.

children.text_ja: 有価証券関連業を営む外国の会社(前号に掲げる会社に該当するものを除く。)
children.text_en: A foreign company engaged in securities-related business (excluding one falling under item (vi)).

children.text_ja: 保険業を営む外国の会社(第六号に掲げる会社に該当するものを除く。)
children.text_en: A foreign company engaged in the insurance business (excluding one falling under item (vi)).

children.text_ja: 信託業を営む外国の会社(第六号に掲げる会社に該当するものを除く。)
children.text_en: A foreign company engaged in the trust business (excluding one falling under item (vi)).

children.text_ja: 次に掲げる業務を専ら営む会社(イに掲げる業務を営む会社にあつては、当該銀行持株会社、その子会社(銀行並びに第一号、第一号の二及び第六号に掲げる会社に限る。)その他これらに類する者として内閣府令で定めるものの営む業務のためにその業務を営んでいるものに限る。) イ 銀行又は前各号に掲げる会社の営む業務に従属する業務として内閣府令で定めるもの ロ 金融関連業務
children.text_en: A company exclusively engaged in the following businesses (for a company engaged in the business under (a), limited to one conducting that business for the businesses of the Bank Holding Company, its subsidiaries limited to banks and companies under items (i), (i-2) and (vi), or similar persons specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance): (a) business specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance as ancillary to the business of a bank or a company under the preceding items; (b) financial-related business.

children.heading: （この抜粋では省略）
children.text_en: Items (xi)-(xiv): additional narrow categories of permitted subsidiary (new-business-development companies, business-improvement companies, regional-revitalization companies, and similar special-purpose entities defined by Cabinet Office Ordinance). Not translated here — outside the FSA notification's cited range (items (i)-(x) and (xv)).

children.text_ja: 子会社対象会社のみを子会社とする持株会社で内閣府令で定めるもの(当該持株会社になることを予定している会社を含む。)
children.text_en: A holding company, specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, that has only Subsidiary-Eligible Companies as its subsidiaries (including a company planning to become such a holding company).

children.heading: （この抜粋では省略）
children.text_en: Item (xvi): the foreign-company equivalent of item (xv) (a foreign holding company holding only Subsidiary-Eligible Companies). Not translated in full here — outside the FSA notification's cited range.
